[[Glacial Gauntlets]] are obtained from [[Hildir]] in [[Jaga Moraine]] in exchange for 100 [[Glacial Stone]]s.

== Notes ==
* These gloves are slightly transparent and cannot be [[dye]]d.
* Similar to all [[Mesmer]] gloves, the Mesmer Glacial Gauntlets [[:File:Glacial_Gauntlets_f_mesmer.jpg|only come up to the wrist]]. For all other [[profession]]s, they do not cover the elbows (unlike other gloves).
* They [[salvage]] into approximately 33 [[Pile of Glittering Dust|Piles of Glittering Dust]].
{{bug|These gloves disappear when underwater.}}

== Trivia ==
* During the preview of [[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]], creating Glacial Gauntlets required only 35 [[Glacial Stone]]s instead of the current 100.
